name: installment-line
title: Installment line
description: The "or pay in 3 × 33.00" line under a price, with a popover for the schedule and terms: parts that add up exactly, fees stated, no provider logo.
docs: price and fee are in minor units. The parts are worked out so they always add up to price plus fee: what does not divide evenly goes on the first payment, and the line says so ("the first 37.52"). interval is week, two-weeks or month. Without now the details say how long after the first each payment is taken, which is the same on the server and in the browser; pass now (and timeZone) to give every payment its date. minPrice and maxPrice are the range you allow: outside it nothing is rendered. A fee of 0 says there is no fee; leave fee out to say nothing. terms is the small print. It has no state of its own, so it renders in a Server Component. installments.ts holds planInstallments and paymentDays, which run on the server too, so the schedule you charge is the one you showed.
